verdict.rationale: Corporations Canada's own docs name a 'registered intermediary' channel with its own fee and processing time. They also describe shared-access roles ('full access manager or filing collaborator') and corporation keys that let others file for a corporation. That is a sanctioned delegated rail, but the evidence only mentions it in passing. Missing for 10: documentation of how a provider becomes a registered intermediary, the scope of what intermediaries or collaborators can do, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company

citations.quote: (if you are a registered intermediary) It will cost $200 and will take 1 day.
